description_en: Updates the metadata of a file without modifying its content
kebab_example: aliyun pds update-file --drive-id 1 --file-id 9520943DC264 --name a.jpg --description VIP_user --labels animal --check-name-mode ignore --local-modified-at 2019-08-20T06:51:27.292Z --hidden true --starred true --api-version 2022-03-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateFile

parameters.help_en: The name of the file. The value must be UTF-8 encoded and no longer than 1,024 bytes
parameters.help_zh: 文件名称，按照 utf8 编码规则最长 1024 字节
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the file. Maximum length: 1,024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 文件描述信息，最长 1024 字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The labels of the file. A maximum of 100 labels are allowed
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表，最多 100 个标签
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en:
The naming policy to apply when a file with the same name already exists. Valid values:

`ignore`: Allow the duplicate file name.

`auto_rename`: Automatically rename the file by appending a timestamp. Example: `xxx_20060102_150405`.

`refuse`: Reject the request and return the details of the existing file.

Default value: `ignore`
parameters.help_zh:
同名文件处理模式，可选值如下：

ignore：允许同名文件；

auto_rename：当发现同名文件时，云端自动重命名，默认为追加当前时间点，如 xxx\_20060102\_150405；

refuse：当云端存在同名文件时，拒绝创建新文件，返回客户端已存在同名文件的详细信息。

默认为 ignore
parameters.name: check_name_mode

parameters.help_en: The modification time of the file on the local device. Specify a UTC timestamp in ISO 8601 format: `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`
parameters.help_zh: 文件本地修改时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ，采用 UTC +0 时区
parameters.name: local_modified_at

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the file is hidden
parameters.name: hidden

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether the file is starred
parameters.name: starred
